name: W Costa Navarino
positioning: The first W hotel in Greece: a beachfront escape for adults and young adults on Navarino Bay in Messinia, with private-pool suites and villas, an infinity-pool WET Deck and access to Costa Navarino's golf
best_for: Couples and friends who want a stylish beach resort with private-pool suites
Active travelers who want golf, watersports and fitness alongside the beach

facts.text: W Costa Navarino is the debut of the W Hotels brand in Greece.
The design is inspired by the region's architecture and natural materials like stone, wood and reed.
Work from upcoming Greek artists hangs on the natural stone walls.
The sandy beach in front of the hotel stretches for 450 meters.
Room choices include bay, marina and panorama view rooms and swim-up rooms in the gardens.
A 25-meter outdoor lap pool sits just outside the FIT gym.
A watersports hub offers diving, windsurfing and kitesurfing for all levels.
Navarino Agora, with dining, shopping, open-air entertainment and events, is steps away.
Guests can learn traditional Messinian cooking from local women in a village home in Pylos.
Nearby Navarino Dunes has the first European Mouratoglou Tennis Center.
Parelia serves Messenian cuisine as sharing plates.
Costa Navarino has four signature golf courses.

highlights.text: The hotel is set beachfront by the Ionian Sea in Navarino Bay.
The one- and two-bedroom Escape Agora and W Suites have private pools steps from the beach or on a rooftop with views of Navarino Bay.
The three-bedroom Oasis I and II Villas, in the gardens or on the beachfront, have private pools of up to 40 square meters.
The WET Deck has an expansive infinity pool overlooking the sea.
AWAY Spa offers tailor-made treatments, mani-pedis, a sauna and a steam room.

considerations.text: The hotel is for adults and young adults aged 12 and over.
The resort is 45 minutes from Kalamata and a 2.5-hour drive from Athens.
Conde Nast Traveler notes there isn't much local nightlife for those seeking a party scene.
